The ring value is worked out in this way.
step 1 Add the numbers along the inside edges of the large square to get L.
step 2 Add the numbers along the inside edges of the small square to get S. DO NOT WRITE IN THIS MARGIN
step 3 Calculate L - S . This is the ring value.
This is because 3 is the top left number in the ring.
